source.name: Fybertech 4chan Archive (pages in 4chan's own markup)
source.short-desc: The subset of the Fybertech crawl saved as 4chan's own HTML rather than fybertech's rendered template.
source.capture: The 20 pages inside the fybertech crawl that are 4chan's own markup -- postContainer wrappers with data-utc timestamps -- rather than fybertech's rendered template, so chan-html reads them and fybertech-html skips them. Mostly /co/ and /v/, 2012-2014. Shares the staged out/ directory with the fybertech source: each adapter ignores what belongs to the other, so both can run over the same tree without double-counting. Unlike the rest of the crawl these carry real UTC epochs, so their timestamps are second-accurate.
